It uses compressed air or suppressors to close off a section of pipe ▷ The valve closes in a matter of milliseconds when triggered by a spark or explosion detector and can be mounted in all directions ▷ Main advantage of these systems is that the flow inside the pipe remains unobstructed as opposed to the passive valves ▷ Irmaco has recently started to target the active valve segment with maintenance services (requires regular annual maintenance and revisions every 5 years). They do not require a power supply ▷ Applied in environments with relatively clean air (i.e., without too much dust; e.g., pharma) ▷ Typical lifespan of a valve is c. 20 to 25 years, but maintenance contracts provide recurring revenues.
